import os,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def bboxes(gi):
    out=[]
    for c in sorted(set(x for r in gi for x in r)):
        if c==0: continue
        pts=[(i,j) for i in range(len(gi)) for j in range(len(gi[0])) if gi[i][j]==c]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(p[0] for p in pts),max(p[0] for p in pts),min(p[1] for p in pts),max(p[1] for p in pts)
        out.append((c,r0,r1,c0,c1))
    return out
for name in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    gi=G[name+' input']; go=G[name+' output']
    print('===',name)
    for c,r0,r1,c0,c1 in bboxes(gi):
        h,w=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
        inn_n=sum(1 for i in range(r0+1,r1) for j in range(c0+1,c1) if gi[i][j]==c)
        oinn_n=sum(1 for i in range(r0+1,r1) for j in range(c0+1,c1) if go[i][j]==c)
        op=frozenset((i-r0,j-c0) for i in range(r0+1,r1) for j in range(c0+1,c1) if go[i][j]==c)
        ip=frozenset((i-r0,j-c0) for i in range(r0+1,r1) for j in range(c0+1,c1) if gi[i][j]==c)
        print(f'c={c} {h}x{w} in_n={inn_n} out_n={oinn_n} unchanged={ip==op}')
